authority: Owner: implementer det og kjør; bounded targeted improvement after the original 31 configurations

ranking.aggregation: body-token-weighted mean within each view, normalize, equal text/context view mean, normalize
ranking.parent_scoring: one cosine per original parent; no max over windows
ranking.overflow: refuse any generated input over the existing 128-token limit

packing.order: first highest ranked packet per document, then remaining packets in original rank order
packing.unit: seed plus contiguous same-heading continuations and nearest preceding strict heading ancestor, whole text
packing.deduplication: exact normalized body plus document/title/section/jurisdiction; identical scope only
packing.budget: atomic unit acceptance using the locked complete grounded prompt tokenizer; no partial trimming or refill below top16

combined_policy: All three unconditional variants fixed before scoring; no adaptive choice based on first two scores
selection: No automatic winner. Review every covered requirement loss and new safety flag before any recommendation.
technical_correction: Pre-scoring revision: explicit delimiter after partial subword header; original unjudged diagnostics preserved; no score-driven tuning
